name: User Provisioning
summary:
*   Role: Product Manager at HotWax Commerce.
    *   Audience: Enthusiastic Retailer (cares about improvements and new features).
    *   Goal: Summarize a cluster of updates into one cohesive release note entry.
    *   Structure (New Features/Enhancements): Problem, Solution, Impact.
    *   Structure (Bug Fixes): "Fixed a bug if [Condition], [Symptom]."
    *   Style: Simple, active voice, granular but concise (3-4 sentences for features, 1 for bugs).
    *   Tone: Professional, utility-focused.
    *   Constraints: No "AI slop" (enhanced, streamlined, seamless, robust), no exclamation points, no "dev-time bugs" (treat as polished features), no "fixed/issue/bug" for new features.
    *   Output: Just the summary text.

    *   *Item 1 & 2 (oms#820, #765):*
        *   Content: Added Solr indexing for application users, added `PartyContent` entity for user profile images, added APIs for managing party roles.
        *   Theme: User Management capabilities (searchability and profiles).
        *   Category: New Feature/Enhancement.

    *   *Item 3 (oms#782):*
        *   Content: Introduced `
